name: preview_slots
description: List the preview slots: the pages the person has opened in the right pane browser, newest first, with target, last activity, request and error counts and the settings in force.

name: preview_network
description: Network log of the page in the right pane browser, like Chrome DevTools' Network tab: requests of the page and its dev server, and the page's fetch/XHR/beacons to other sites. Oldest first, the newest `limit` of the `matched` ones. Call again with since=<cursor> to read only what is new.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

since.description: `cursor` of an earlier call: only entries after it

third_party.description: Only requests to other sites than the page

name: preview_console
description: Console of the page in the right pane browser: console.* calls, uncaught exceptions, unhandled rejections and failed requests, oldest first. Identical entries in a row are folded into one with a count.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

since.description: `cursor` of an earlier call: only entries after it

level.description: This level and worse: warn gives warnings and errors

name: preview_server_log
description: Terminal output of the dev server behind the page: by default only lines that look like errors or warnings. `reason` says why there is no source (an external site, nobody listens on the port).

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

all.description: Every recent line, not only problems

lines.description: How many lines to look back over

name: preview_get_settings
description: Throttling, blocked URL patterns and cache setting of a preview slot.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

name: preview_set_throttle
description: Throttle the network of the page like DevTools does: a preset (fast-4g, slow-4g, 3g, offline) or custom numbers. It applies to requests made after the call, so reload the page to see the effect. Set preset none when done: the person sees the page slowed down.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

preset.description: none, fast-4g, slow-4g, 3g, offline, or custom (then latency_ms, down_kbps and up_kbps are required)

latency_ms.description: custom only: added to every request, ms

down_kbps.description: custom only: download speed shared by the slot's requests, kbit/s; 0 = unlimited

up_kbps.description: custom only: upload speed, kbit/s; 0 = unlimited

name: preview_block
description: Block requests of the page whose URL contains a pattern, or matches one with `*`, to see how the page behaves without them. At most 50 patterns. Blocked requests show up in preview_network with blocked=true. Remove the patterns when done.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

add.description: Patterns to block: a part of the URL (`posthog`, `/api/orders`) or a pattern with `*` (`*.google-analytics.com/*`)

remove.description: Patterns to unblock, as they were added

name: preview_set_cache
description: disable_cache=true: the page is served with no-store and the proxy skips its asset cache, so every load is a cold one. false restores the default.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last

name: preview_clear
description: Empty the network and console logs of a slot, to read only what a next action does. Settings stay.

slot.description: Slot origin (https://ai-<handle>-<n>.<domain>) from preview_slots; by default the one the person used last
